content.comment_body: I previously upgraded from version 5 to 6 without any issues, but now when trying to upgrade to version 7, I'm being prompted for an address. What information needs to be entered there? Thanks in advance!

Hello, I think this refers to the directory where the older version is installed. If you don't have a previous installation, you should use a CD containing the earlier version and browse to its files. See [url] for more details. Regards,

Thanks [user_name], but that solution isn't working. It seems to require an internet address to download the upgrade. Should I reinstall my original version 5 disk? For context: I installed version 5 from disk, downloaded version 6 online, and now when I try the same for version 7, I'm asked for an address. Previously, the address was automatically filled in during installation. Any other suggestions? Thanks in advance!
Hello, Are you referring to automatic updates through the Help-update center? Try downloading the update manually from [url]. Regards,
Thanks! It appears to be working, although the download speed is very slow (around 11K/s). I just hope this isn't a trial version.
Hello, It works, and it's not a demo version. Regards,

"The struggle continues"... After the download finished, I ran the setup program, but the installer keeps prompting me to select another location. I've tried every location on my hard drive, but it won't proceed with the installation and keeps repeating the prompt. The IT department mentioned that "InstallAnywhere" isn't managed on our computers, so it's probably included with the upgrade I downloaded. What should I try next?
I haven't experienced that issue before. Try performing the upgrade again through the Help tab; it might resolve the problem.

Finally, everything works! After reviewing my previous download, I noticed the setup file was only about 13MB. I downloaded again, received a 66MB file, and the speed was much faster (around 400K/s). Apparently, the [company_name] download server had issues yesterday, but everything turned out well. Thanks for your help everyone!

analysis.insight_summary: Users upgrading from earlier versions of [product_name] encountered unclear prompts requesting an 'address' without detailed instructions. Additional challenges included slow downloads and repetitive installation loops caused by incomplete installer files. Ultimately, users succeeded after obtaining the full installer through a faster connection, though the overall upgrade experience highlighted the need for improved guidance and more robust installation procedures.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate a straightforward upgrade process with clear instructions, automated handling of necessary files, and reliable download and installation performance, much like their previous experiences.
